chunks: “Allah, Blessed and Exalted, revealed to Musa ibn 'Imran عليه السلام: ‘Do you know why I chose you for My speech over My creation?’ Musa said: ‘No, my Lord.’”

He said: ‘O Musa, I examined My servants inwardly and outwardly, and I did not find among them anyone more humble in soul before Me than you. O Musa, when you perform salat (prayer), you place your cheeks upon the earth.’”

key_terms.أَذَلَّ: more humble and lowly before Allah
key_terms.التُّرَابِ: the earth or dust, symbolizing humility

ai.seo_question: Why did Allah choose Musa عليه السلام for His speech over the rest of creation?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that true nearness to Allah comes through humility and lowliness before Him. Allah chose Musa عليه السلام for divine speech because of his deep self-abasement before his Lord, expressed in worship through placing his cheeks on the earth.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.975 - Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said:
"Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, revealed to Musa (as), son of Imran (as):
'Do you know why I have chosen you to speak to Me over all of My creation?'
Musa (as) replied: 'No, my Lord (azj).'
Allah (swt) said: 'O’ Musa (as), I searched My servants thoroughly and did not find anyone who humbled themselves before Me more than you. When you pray, you place your cheeks on the ground.'"
